direction: Mixed, irregular woodland with exposed curved branches, airy birch crowns, broad oak foliage, asymmetrical conifers and young growth; muted olive, straw and dark leaf litter retain the crash-world palette.
placement: World-seeded candidates with 92-unit spacing across tile boundaries; shared continuous woodland, moisture and patch fields. Mature trees thin through scrub and grass. Roads, entrances, lesson sites and portals remain clear.
rendering: Instanced geometry, shared scanned bark maps and botanical RGBA atlas, geometry-derived frustum bounds, horizon fade, projected pilot-area foliage fading, subtle wind with reduced-motion support.
physics: Trunk radii derive from visual species/height/width; same immutable tree positions drive visuals, movement, projectiles and flight.

validation.geometry: Eight distinct crown bounds; all tree meshes below 3000 triangles; finite attributes and outward bark faces; no degenerate grass tips.
validation.ecology: All four tree families present; cross-tile minimum spacing and deterministic distribution verified; habitat weights continuous; matching physical trunks and flight clearance.
validation.gameplay: 81 routes / 690 segments, 2311 real navigation frames, 21 building entrances, 4929 mountain/bridge/cave movement frames passed.
validation.rendering: Terrain worker/main-thread exact geometry parity, conservative instance culling and cave cleanup passed. Browser WebGL material compile and foliage alpha verified.
validation.ground: Road coverage is a dedicated per-vertex channel preserved through worker transfer/indexing; regional albedo no longer suppresses meadow cover. Authored tracks explicitly retain bare soil. Regression tests confirm bare road centers and zero road influence outside paths.
validation.profile: Representative warm pre-final capture: 22.5 FPS, 21.73 ms GPU, 15.76 ms CPU at the original woodland viewpoint. Concurrent machine activity and scene/viewport affect performance; no 60 FPS claim.
